original_test_intent: Install the approved Linux release and complete required package set from USB onto the designated RAID VD, reboot into a workable system and verify no unexplained system-log errors, failures or warnings.
original_method: A qualified operator boots signed media through KVM, confirms the exact RAID target and layout, supervises installation and one reboot, while the agent records package provenance, boot/storage state and complete installer, journal, kernel and BMC evidence.
manual_activity: User approves signed media, package manifest/repository, exact VD, layout and recovery; operator supervises USB/KVM target selection and reboot; agent assists only within that plan.
required_inputs: Required package manifest, repository snapshot/signing and network/credential policy
RAID VD stable identity and all non-target exclusions
Partition, filesystem, bootloader/UEFI, encryption and RAID-driver plan
Backup image, KVM/OOB, maintenance window, known-event allowlist and recovery
safety_requirements: Reconcile controller VD identity with installer target before formatting
Use only signed media, trusted repository and approved packages
Preserve pre-install boot/storage/BMC evidence and complete installer logs
Stop on target, signature/repository, package, partition, bootloader, storage or unexplained-log error
Do not expose credentials, auto-repartition, suppress events, repair or repeatedly reboot
agent_execution_scope: Capture full controller/VD/drive and boot baseline
Validate media, repository/package manifest and supported RAID driver
Assist only with approved guarded installation and record all package/installer output
After one reboot verify active root/boot VD, packages, driver/storage health and logs; do not choose target or issue verdict
engineer_actions: Approve media/package target/layout and event/recovery policies
Provide KVM/operator and own data-loss/boot recovery decisions
Review installer, package, boot, storage and log evidence and decide PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Generic scripted deployment is possible only after target and package policy approval; it otherwise omits physical USB/KVM boot, all-packages meaning and complete post-reboot log review.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use the approved installer or guarded answer file bound to the exact RAID VD, archive package/repository results, then collect bootloader, root/storage, installed-package and complete journal/dmesg/syslog evidence after one reboot.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: USB boot, Linux installation with all approved packages, reboot/workability, event-log review and source 5/20 timing fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Perform a stable-target signed-media deployment against a pinned package manifest/repository with operator confirmation at destructive steps and full post-boot evidence.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Makes all-packages, bootloader and target semantics auditable without reducing source scope.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Automation assists but cannot infer package completeness or select a destructive target.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Repository drift can change installed content even with identical media; evidence must preserve repository snapshot and resulting package manifest.

project_override_considerations: If all packages literally means a vendor-defined installer profile rather than every repository package, the approved profile name/version is authoritative and must be recorded.
expected_evidence: Approval, signed media and distribution/kernel/support matrix
Pinned repository/profile and installed package manifest
Pre/post controller VD/drive map and exact selected target
KVM/USB plus one-reboot record, active root/boot target and driver/storage health
Complete journal/dmesg/syslog/BMC/SEL, event triage, backup/recovery and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Master consistently defines Linux installation, packages, reboot and logs; reference differences concern detail rather than source identity or semantics.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Media, package policy, target, operator and recovery are supplyable prerequisites; static review is complete.

review_improvement: Defines all-packages and repository provenance while protecting the destructive RAID target and preserving full post-reboot Linux evidence.
independent_technical_reasoning: Linux installer disk order and package selection are environment-dependent. A bootable system can still be on the wrong VD, lack required packages or contain storage/kernel faults, so the test needs stable controller-to-installer identity, a pinned package definition and complete installer plus post-boot root, driver and journal evidence.
